name: Shabbat & Holiday Mode
description: Blocks or warns on posts and logins during Shabbat and Yom Tov based on each user's location-based zmanim (halachic times).

settings_schema.header: Configure Shabbat & Holiday Mode to automatically restrict activity during Shabbat and Yom Tov.
settings_schema.footer: Times are sourced from the HebCal zmanim API based on each user's stored city/country.

settings.help_text: Number of minutes before sunset that Shabbat mode activates. Default is 18.
Number of minutes after nightfall (Tzet HaKochavim) that Shabbat mode deactivates. Default is 42.
warn: Show a Shabbat warning but allow the post. block: Silently reject the post. queue: Hold the post and deliver it after Havdalah.
Optional API key for the HebCal zmanim service (https://www.hebcal.com). Leave blank to use the free unauthenticated endpoint.

settings.display_name: Default City (for users without a stored location)
settings.help_text: City name used for zmanim when a user has not set their location. E.g. 'New York', 'Jerusalem', 'London'.
